limitations: This is an ER-2 source and observation-ledger review. This verifier issued no physical-device, simulator, browser or GUI commands and did not operate Xcode installation, launch, app data, timers or system surfaces.

The Xcode two-scheme deployment sequence and absence of destructive actions or personal-data mutation are coordinator observations, not independently replayed or exhaustively proven by these selected logs. Readiness and version queries cannot cryptographically identify installed binaries, inspect installed extensions, prove automatic companion installation or establish existing-data preservation.

Both apps were initially absent. There is no evidence here of an in-place upgrade, preservation of a prior store or migration from the public 0.1.0 build 2. No broader AC-1 preservation claim is certified by this ER-2 receipt.
